traits.rule: One heavy display face, one weight only. Anton (or an Anton-class condensed grotesk) is the default; see aliases per preset.
ALL CAPS. Maximum density and aggression, never sentence case.
A manual stroke, thick, drawn UNDER the fill via paint-order: stroke fill (or strokeText-before-fillText on canvas). Sized as a percentage of cap height, not a fixed px.
A hard, dark, offset-down shadow for sticker-style depth, not a soft ambient glow.
One punchy color per headline: white, a warm gradient, or an acid accent. Never mix more than one treatment in the same headline.
Tight letter-spacing (around -0.01em to -0.02em) and a line-height near 0.9 so lines lock together like a logotype.

placement_rule: 2 to 4 words max, never a full sentence. Never over the subject's face - place in a free quarter (bottom, corner, or side). Cap height 12-18% of the frame height; when in doubt, go bigger. Keep comfortable padding inside the frame, off the extreme edges.
implementation_note: Author these as a set_stylesheet rule targeting the headline class (for example .thumb-headline), never as inline per-element styles - repeating the class keeps every headline in the project on one edit point.

items.title: Beast - white with a thick black stroke
items.css: .thumb-headline { font-family: 'Anton', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 0.9; color: #ffffff; -webkit-text-stroke: 0.11em #000000; paint-order: stroke fill; text-shadow: 0 8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 0 14px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); }
items.placement: Bottom-center or a free bottom corner, never crossing the subject's face; keep 6-8% frame padding from the bottom edge.

items.title: Fire - yellow to orange to red gradient
items.css: .thumb-headline { font-family: 'Anton', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 0.9; -webkit-text-stroke: 0.11em #1a0a00; paint-order: stroke fill; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFE24B 0%, #FF9A1F 45%, #FF2E2E 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(255,120,0,0.55)) drop-shadow(0 10px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4)); }
items.placement: Bottom-center or a free side panel; the warm gradient reads best against a darker background area of the image.

items.title: Neon Lime - acid lime with a glow
items.css: .thumb-headline { font-family: 'Anton', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 0.9; color: #D4FF3F; -webkit-text-stroke: 0.10em #0a1400; paint-order: stroke fill; text-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(180,255,40,0.7), 0 10px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
items.placement: Any free quarter with a mid-to-dark background behind it so the glow reads; avoid placing over light or busy areas.

items.title: Clean Glass - frosted pill, no stroke
items.css: .thumb-headline { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; letter-spacing: -0.02em; background: rgba(20,20,25,0.45); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); padding: 0.12em 0.5em; border-radius: 0.2em; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
items.placement: Bottom-third as a pill-shaped band; works best on busy or bright backgrounds where a stroke-only treatment would lose legibility.

items.title: Marker - black Anton on lime line-boxes
items.css: .thumb-headline { font-family: 'Anton', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 0.9; color: #0a0a0a; background: #D4FF3F; box-decoration-break: clone; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; padding: 0 0.18em; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
items.placement: Stacked short lines in a free corner, each line its own highlighted box; reads like a marker-highlighted note over the scene.
